mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.5%, it signals active monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals monetary tightening combined with slowing supply growth, indicating an impending economic slowdown that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and INDPRO rise by at least 0.2% over the prior month, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand momentum that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 in late-cycle periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates immediate strength in consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with near-term corporate revenue acceleration and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increases by at least 0.3% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals synchronized demand and supply expansion, which drives corporate earnings acceleration and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO rise by at least 0.3% over the prior month, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent price pressures that may force further rate hikes, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in tightening cycles.
